events.title: Lumen Technologies to acquire Alkira for $475 million
events.body: The all-cash deal pairs Alkira's cloud-native software with Lumen's fiber network to target a $70 billion addressable market

events.title: Lumen Posts Wider-Than-Expected Q1 Loss, Revenues Drop Y/Y
events.body: LUMN posts wider Q1 loss as revenues fall 9%, while strategic sales hit 51% and an Alkira deal targets faster-growing east-west cloud connectivity.

events.title: Lumen (LUMN) Reports Q1 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
events.body: Lumen (LUMN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -754.55% and +2.07%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
